create_LiTModel: create a LiTModel instance by passing a model and model name to initialize the zero-shot image-text model
run_forward_batch: run forward_batch on a LiTModel to get zero-shot predictions or image-text relations for a batch of images
build_zeroshot_weights: build zeroshot classification weights from class names and text templates using the LiTModel text encoder
get_image_embeddings: get normalized image embeddings from a batch of images using the LiTModel image encoder
get_text_embeddings: get normalized text embeddings from caption options using the LiTModel text encoder
